name: A2A Connector
description: Connect this OpenClaw agent to an A2A Relay

local.description: auto prefers native A2A, provisions compatibility A2A only when absent; or explicit HTTP(S) origin

openclawBinary.description: Host OpenClaw CLI executable, never a bundled replacement

openclawArgs.description: Global CLI arguments, e.g. --profile reviewer; use the same Gateway profile

openclawAgent.description: Host agent ID for compatibility tasks (separate from Relay agentId)

localTokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding local A2A bearer token
